skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting numerators when denominators are identical.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominators
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Manipulation
skills.definition: Subtracting the whole number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing 1 from the whole number part when the fractional subtraction yields a negative value.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the resulting fraction to its lowest terms.
